title: UDP Send
text: Send UDP packets to UDP host, 2 inputs; {Remote IP address (255.255.255.255 for broadcast)} sets the iP address of receiving UDP host, {Remote IP Port} sets the iP port on receiving UDP host, {Local IP Port (-1 for automatic port assignment)} sets the iP port on sending UDP host, {Enable variable length} sets the variable length and {Wait until previous packet transmitted} sets the wait to sent new packets. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Remote IP address (255.255.255.255 for broadcast)
params.values: IP address of receiving UDP host 192.168.1.10 (default) | 255.255.255.255

params.name: Remote IP Port
params.values: IP port on receiving UDP host 25000 (default) | positive integer in the range [1,65535]

params.name: Local IP Port (-1 for automatic port assignment)
params.values: IP port on sending UDP host -1 (default) |

params.name: Wait until previous packet transmitted
params.values: Wait to sent new packets off (default) | on
